Key Features
- Space-saving, innovative and stylish, LG's WashTower brings ease to your Laundry Room
- Improved fabric care and simplified operation with smart AI Direct Drive and Smart Pairing
- Blitz through a 5kg load in just 39 minutes with TurboWash™360 tech, maintaining quality.
- The DUAL Inverter Heat Pump cycles faster and more effectively, with a 10 year warranty.
- With Allergy Care cycles on washer and dryer the LG WashTower reduces allergens by 99.99%
- LG's Auto Cleaning Condenser automatically cleans the condenser each cycle.

sections.headline: Built-in intelligence takes out the guesswork
sections.body:
Auto sense AIDD technology detects the most suitable wash cycle to handle your clothes with care.
-desktop-resize.jpg)
disclaimers: *Tested by Intertek on May 2022. Cotton cycle with 2 kg load compared to LG Conventional Cotton cycle. (F13EJN) Tested average fabric damage by inserting 5-hole swatches and comparing AI Class 1 vs AI Class 3 in Cotton cycle.
*The results may be different depending on the clothes and environment.
*For Cotton, Mixed Fabric, Easy Care cycles only.

sections.headline: Complete washing and drying in an hour
sections.body: The dryer starts to preheat before the end of washing, so drying takes less time.
disclaimers: *Tested by Intertek. Tested with 3 each load conditions; Women sportswear(polyester 89%, spandex 11%, 3 sheets of shirts(polyester 65%, cotton 35%), and two pair of pajamas(cotton 73%, polyester 27%). Tested with Speed Wash (Quick Wash) cycle on washer, Small Load (Quick Dry) cycle on dryer and "Prepare to Dry" option.
*The results may be differenct depending on the clothes and environment.

assets.alt: Wash and dry in under an hour

sections.headline: Get your laundry done in less time
sections.body:
Your laundry can be thoroughly cleaned in just 39 minutes without compromising fabric protection.
Allergy care
disclaimers: *Tested by Intertek on January 2023, Cotton program with TurboWash option with 2kg load.
*The results may be different depending on the environment.

sections.headline: Reduce live house dust mites
sections.body:
Wear your clothes confidently knowing that the LG allergy care cycle reduces live house dust mites.
Intelligent Washer and Dryer Solution

disclaimers: *Allergy Care cycle approved by BAF (British Allergy Foundation) reduces house dust mites allergen.
*Hygiene program can be downloaded via the ThinQ app or selected directly from Cloud Cycle within the app.
*Tested by Intertek, Hygiene program in washer reduces bacteria (S. aureus, P. aeruginosa, and K. pneumoniae) with 3.6kg of cotton test load.

sections.headline: An energy-saving   way to dry
sections.body: The dual cylinders allow for faster drying and energy saving.

assets.alt: Left - Allergy Care by Washer , right - Allergy Care by Dryer
Comparison video of conventional inverter and dual inverter.

sections.headline: Condenser with convenient cleaning
sections.body:
The auto cleaning condenser self-cleans, ensuring hassle-free maintenance for you.
[Learn more about ThinQ app](https://www.lg.com/uk/thinq-up/)
disclaimers: *The cleanliness of the condenser may differ depending on the environment.
*Tested by Intertek on January 2021. Cotton(Normal) cycle with 3.83 kg load compared to LG conventional heater dryer. (RC90V9AV2W vs. RC9066A3F)
*The frequency of running ‘auto cleaning condenser’ may vary depending on the size the initial moisture amount of the laundry.
*Product images are for illustrative purposes only and may differ from actual product. Refer to product image gallery.

assets.alt: The image shows how fine dust generated during the drying process is purified through three filters in the condenser.

sections.headline: Efficient maintenance
sections.body: The LG ThinQ app  continuously monitors your washer. Whether it’s everyday maintenance or something else, the app allows you to easily monitor energy usage. You can also get smart notifications and download the course you like.

sections.headline: Smart connectivity
sections.body: The LG ThinQ™ app allows you to easily connect with your washer in a way you never could before. Start your washer with just the tap of a button.

assets.alt: LG stacked washer-dryer with energy monitoring app, surrounded by lush plants, offers efficiency and style.

sections.headline: Voice-assisted control
sections.body: Tell you washer exactly what you need, when you need it. Say “What cycle is the washer?” and the AI speaker will listen and check the cycle to let you know.
disclaimers: *Support for smart home devices that are compatible with Alexa and Google Assistant may vary by country and your individual smart home setup.
